en.name: Basilica of Our Lady of Peace, Yamoussoukro
en.summary: The largest church building in the world by area, built in Ivory Coast's capital and consecrated by Pope St. John Paul II.
en.body: Completed in 1989 at the initiative of Ivorian president Félix Houphouët-Boigny and consecrated by Pope St. John Paul II in 1990, the basilica at Yamoussoukro holds the Guinness World Record for the largest church building on earth.
